entities.name: A9FFI1
observations: Reviewed Sorangium cellulosum pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase; annotated with EC 2.4.2.1 and EC 2.4.2.2.

Catalyzes reversible phosphorolysis of diverse nucleosides to D-ribose 1-phosphate plus the corresponding free base; reported substrates include uridine, adenosine, guanosine, cytidine, thymidine, inosine, and xanthosine.

entities.name: Nucleoside phosphorolysis
observations: General reaction: purine or pyrimidine D-ribonucleoside + phosphate ⇌ corresponding nucleobase + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.

Representative reactions include guanosine + phosphate ⇌ guanine + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate; adenosine + phosphate ⇌ adenine + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate; inosine + phosphate ⇌ hypoxanthine + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate; cytidine + phosphate ⇌ cytosine + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.
Associated EC assignments in homologs are 2.4.2.1 and 2.4.2.2; Rhea references include RHEA:13233, RHEA:19805, RHEA:27642, RHEA:27646, and RHEA:52540.
